name: UNISEM
recent: Unisem 在 2026 年 11 月有多项董事及大股东持股变动申报，主席 John Chia Sin Tet 与执行董事 Francis Chia Mong Tet 连续数日增持公司股份。公司于 11 月 6 日公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利按年大幅增长并宣布派发 1 仙中期股息。
notable: 主席 John Chia Sin Tet 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日至 19 日期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
执行董事 Francis Chia Mong Tet 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日及 16 日间接增持公司股份。
公司公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，净利按年增长并宣布派发每股 1 仙中期股息。
risks: 董事在业绩公布后连续多日增持股份，相关交易已依上市条例申报。
有新闻标题指出公司盈利质量存在潜在问题，需留意相关分析。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收为 RM607.66 million，按年增长 27.9%，按季增长 6.6%；净利为 RM30.73 million，按年增长 236.5%，按季增长 210.1%；净利率为 5.1%，高于上一季度的 1.7%。

recent_en: In November 2026, Unisem made multiple announcements on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, with Chairman John Chia Sin Tet and Executive Director Francis Chia Mong Tet acquiring shares over consecutive days. On 6 November, the company reported its 3Q FY2026 results, with net profit rising sharply year-on-year and declared a 1 sen interim dividend.
notable_en: Chairman John Chia Sin Tet acquired shares in the open market multiple times between 13 and 19 November 2026.
Executive Director Francis Chia Mong Tet indirectly acquired shares on 12 and 16 November 2026.
The company announced its 3Q FY2026 results, with net profit rising year-on-year, and declared a 1 sen interim dividend per share.
risks_en: Directors acquired shares over consecutive days after the results announcement, with the transactions reported under listing requirements.
A news headline flagged potential issues underlying the company's earnings, warranting attention to the analysis.
earnings_en: 3Q FY2026 revenue was RM607.66 million, up 27.9% year-on-year and 6.6% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM30.73 million, up 236.5% year-on-year and 210.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 5.1%, higher than 1.7% in the previous quarter.
